verdict.rationale: A state business-filing system like the SCC's Clerk's Information System could plausibly publish a machine-readable API spec, so this axis applies. The evidence pack contains only robots.txt probes that block crawling, and none of them documents an OpenAPI or equivalent spec, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
